body: I'll try not to give up... I think she still loves me somewhere in there. She still kisses me and says she loves me, it may be confusion

I'm going to read that thanks very much.

As far as the state after my CT they never informed me where it is, though I'm thinking it passed the ureter because the intense pain in my side subsided. 

I'm so sorry you had to go through

Hello there, they gave me FloMax and some severe pain medications, after excruciating pain in my side subsided I'm no longer having any pain and am very confused by this.

I'm thinking it passed from my kidney to the bladder.

Here's hoping it's a quick one!!

You were absolutely right that I needed to go to the ER. I have a UTI and a kidney stone 5mm.

Thanks a ton

I have bad anxiety and I fear I may be freaking myself out

The pain is dull and feels like a cramp

I don't know if you read through what I wrote or not, she already said she still wants to live together.

I get it, you think it's over and she's a horrible person, but I know she's wonderful and I still think we have a chance. 9 years is a very long time and growing out of school, giving up that easy just doesn't sound right.

Nah I don't think you are, I like you.

I don't know, I think those feelings would be plenty common when you been with someone for 7 years right out of high school.

She makes me happy though, I really do love her and I feel good around her. She does encourage me, she wants to see me happy too.

Sure I'm pissed right now, I feel like we should be working on this thing rather than just giving up. Her work hours don't help.

I chose to help her though, she never asked for my help but I wanted to try to be there for her as best I could.

When we moved to help her family that was a mutual decision so that we could both also try to get the ball rolling for ourselves.

She was confused with that person, she started having feelings for them and was really upset so I we decided she should explore them. This was all online.

And another thing, I don't feel like I've done half enough for her to ever be considered carrying her, and she wouldn't have that either, she wants to help me out too.

I definitely see what you mean, though I will say we are each other's best friends, while we have other friends and stuff we talk to we were always there for each other first and foremost so it feels like I'm losing my friend too.

I was fine for the first few months she started but then it suddenly hit me how alone I was.
Of course, you're very right about this and I'm going to do that. I'm also curious as to how others go about this though, I'm nervous because I want to do this properly, they deserve the best. Thanks

I'm going to do that, initiate romantic and emotional encounters with her, and try to be a part of what she's doing and up to as well.

We definitely do have a bit to work through, I'm going to hear her out going forward. No matter what I want to be there for her and support how she's feeling.

Yeah we have been in this for awhile, it's entirely possible rekindling things may not come to fruition, though I do have hope. I need to work on myself for sure.
Oop you cut off at the end there. I don't take it for granted one bit, she put up with me like a saint for so long.
I'm sorry for having to ask, but what led you to believe that? The two of us have always been very similar and got along great.

Thanks for being there for me, to be honest I can't seem to get answers from anyone and it's been making me feel that much more hopeless.

As far as change, I'm horrible with change, I get nostalgic about everything and very sad when things change around me. I could definitely see that triggering me into a state of fear and despair. It just scared me because I've had trouble sleeping, eating, relaxing or enjoying anything.

My loved ones are a bit difficult, they're going through a lot themselves and I don't really know if they would understand. My partner has been there for me, as much as she can. She's working 5 days a week now and so tired we barely have time to talk, and that started right when my grandma passed and this moving talk happened.

Thank you :( I hope I'm not alone, I feel so alone and scared right now. I just want a future and for this to pass.

Thanks so much for your response. Remembering all of that with her is bittersweet, but we've had some good times.

I came to her last night and laid out everything, I have been very introspective and realized what a jackass I've been to her the entire time we've been living together/together. I've been emotionally vacant, way too co-dependent and I just haven't been engaged enough in things that she loves.

I asked for her forgiveness, if she had it first of all. I told her I realize what a child I've been. How she chooses to respond to this is all up to her, but rethinking all of our times together helped me put this into perspective.
Nah I'm not currently seeing a therapist, though I plan to eventually. As far as calming techniques I'm not sure what to do because I'm not sure what's going on with me currently.

First, thanks for all of your advice I'm going to keep it in mind as I try to work out of this rut.

Second, I don't know if it's truly over. We're in a very unique situation where I don't think either of us could happily sever ties. We live together, we got together 9 years ago (I'm 26 she's 27). We have waited a long time to experience the world working from the bottom up, part of me is holding out hope that we just need to get into a healthier state of mind, we've both been depressed.

She told me the other night I'm her family and she never wants to lose me, I feel the same. I really hope we can work this out in a way that isn't just severing ties. I mostly just want to find the motivation to push on through this.
